fieldValues.title: 13. Systems the first pass missed
fieldValues.thinking_reached:
- Slash commands that add or classify work: triage, stories and roadmap in srs, srs-rust, srs-web, srs-vscode and clerk; ship in srs-rust and clerk (ship-web in srs-web); rfc and author in srs; session and routines in clerk; epic-worker and epic-coordinator still in srs (and epic-worker in srs-rust) although muDemocracy.org's AGENTS.md calls them retired; enrich and review in muDemocracy.org.
- PR templates: .github/pull_request_template.md in srs, srs-rust, srs-web, srs-vscode and muDemocracy.org, each its own. No repo has an issue template (clerk#224).
- Clerk routines that move work: bug-fixer, canary, flow-keeper, synthesiser, wg-analyst, wg-builder, wg-steward, wg-reviewer, handbook-watcher, unattended-worker.
- More label families: desk, plan, no-code, review:requested, requires-spec-rfc, requires-wasm-binding, spec change, quick win, rfc, story:unplanned, workstream, epic-256:*.
- Native GitHub milestones (five in srs-rust).
- Separate workflows: PR upkeep (clerk scripts/upkeep.mjs) and Derive priority in srs-programme.
- The decision-record cell guard in srs (check-decision-cell-tags.mjs), beside the PR classification check.
fieldValues.tensions:
- Slash commands named triage, stories and roadmap exist in five repos; whether they are one command copied or five that drift is not checked.
- Five PR templates, no issue templates.
fieldValues.next_action: Compare the five PR templates and the triage, stories and roadmap commands for drift (planning).
